params.text: IRF540N / IRF9540N (D2PAK) source followers at +/-30 V, driven by emitter followers VT5/VT6 through 47 ohm gate stoppers. 38 W into 8 ohm at 1 % THD, 47 W at 10 %.
Input pair VT1/VT2 with a PNP current mirror (VT11, VT12) and an LED-referenced tail sink (VT3) that also sets the VAS load current (VT10).
The Vbe multiplier VT9 spans both gate thresholds (about 7.7 V); RP1 sets the quiescent current (about 100 mA). Mount VT9 on the heatsink. Gain R5/R4 + 1 = 23 (27 dB).
